title: Mobile Phone Sales Executive
description:
Key Responsibilities

* **Customer Engagement:** Warmly greet walk-in customers, assess their usage needs (budget, camera, battery, performance), and recommend suitable smartphone models and brands.
* **Product Demonstrations:** Live-demonstrate smartphone features, OS functionalities, camera quality, and accessories (earbuds, chargers, covers, screen guards).
* **Sales & Upselling:** Convert walk-in inquiries into confirmed sales, push profitable add-ons/accessories, and achieve monthly unit and revenue targets.
* **Financing & Exchanges:** Assist customers with EMI/finance applications, credit approvals, and old-phone exchange valuations according to company policy.
* **Value-Added Services:** Help customers with SIM card activations, initial device setup, data transfers, and attaching protection plans.
* **Store Upkeep:** Keep display units charged, clean, security-tagged, and organized throughout the shift, while monitoring stock levels.
* **Billing & Records:** Handle point-of-sale (POS) billing accurately and maintain basic logs of daily sales and customer inquiries.

Key Result Areas (KRAs) & KPIs

* **Smartphone Unit & Value Sales:** Measured by monthly quota achievement.
* **Accessory Attach Rate:** Percentage of device sales that include paired accessories or protection plans.
* **Finance / EMI Conversion:** Share of eligible buyers converted into finance or EMI schemes.
* **Walk-in Conversion Rate:** Percentage of store visitors converted into paying customers.
* **Display Maintenance:** 100% compliance on clean, working, and secure live demo handsets.

Qualifications & Requirements

* **Education:** 12th Pass (Higher Secondary) or Graduation preferred.
* **Experience:** 1 to 3 years of retail sales experience, ideally within mobile phones, consumer electronics, or gadget showrooms.
* **Required Skills:**
* Strong working knowledge of current smartphone brands, specs, and mobile operating systems.
* Consultative and customer-friendly communication style (proficiency in local languages like Bengali and Hindi is essential).
* Basic computer and POS billing literacy.
* Target-driven mindset with patience and problem-solving skills.

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹20,000.00 per month

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Park Street, Kolkata, West Bengal: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

Education:

* Higher Secondary(12th Pass) (Required)

Experience:

* Mobile Phone Sales: 1 year (Required)

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Android Developer
description:
Web Spiders Group is a global AI and Customer Experience (CX) technology company with 26+ years of experience helping enterprises and governments transform customer engagement through AI, Voice, Data, and Digital Engineering. With operations across India, Singapore, the UK, and the US, and powered by our flagship platform, SpiderX Phone AI, we enable intelligent, human-like customer interactions at scale. We are seeking an Senior Android Developer with strong knowledge of Android architecture and modern development practices for a white-label staff augmentation engagement. The selected candidate will work directly with the client’s team to build and maintain Android applications.
  

##### **Location**

Kolkata (Onsite) / Remote

##### **Type**

Full Time & Contractual

##### **Department**

Technology

  

We are seeking an **Senior Android Developer** with strong knowledge of Android architecture and modern development practices for a white-label staff augmentation engagement. The selected candidate will work directly with the client’s team to build and maintain Android applications.

**Location:** Kolkata (Onsite) / Remote

**Employment type:** Full-time or contract

**No of Positions:** 2

**Joining:** Immediate

  

### **Key responsibilities:**

* Design, develop, test, and maintain Android applications and reusable modules.
* Apply appropriate architecture patterns to create scalable, maintainable applications.
* Build responsive interfaces and manage application state.
* Integrate APIs, local storage, and third-party libraries.
* Troubleshoot crashes, memory leaks, and performance issues.
* Write unit tests, participate in code reviews, and maintain code quality.
* Collaborate directly with the client’s team on requirements, technical decisions, and delivery.
‍

### **Required skills and technical expertise:**

* 5+ years of hands-on Android development experience with Kotlin and working knowledge of Java.
* Strong understanding of **MVVM, Clean Architecture, separation of concerns, repository patterns, and SOLID principles**.
* Experience with **Android Jetpack**, including ViewModel, Lifecycle, Navigation, and Room.
* Proficiency in **Jetpack Compose and/or XML-based layouts**, including state management and reusable UI components.
* Experience with **Kotlin Coroutines and Flow** for asynchronous operations and reactive data handling.
* Familiarity with dependency injection using **Hilt or Dagger**.
* Experience integrating REST APIs using **Retrofit/OkHttp**, including error handling and authentication.
* Understanding of local persistence, caching, and offline data handling.
* Strong knowledge of Android lifecycle, configuration changes, and process recreation.
* Familiarity with unit and UI testing using tools such as **JUnit, MockK/Mockito, and Espresso or Compose UI tests**.
* Proficiency with Android Studio, Gradle, Git, debugging, and profiling tools.
* Strong problem-solving, communication, and independent delivery skills.
‍

### **Interview process:**

Candidates will attend a **1-2 hours screen-sharing coding round** to build a small Android module followed by 2 technical rounds with the interview panel. Candidates should be prepared to explain their architecture, implementation choices, and approach to code organization.

‍

### **Preparation and guidelines:**

* Have Android Studio installed with a blank Android project ready.
* Keep a working emulator or Android test phone available.
* Online searches and the IDE’s default basic code completion are permitted.
* **AI tools and assistants are strictly prohibited during the interview. All AI plugins must be completely disabled beforehand. Any use of AI will result in immediate disqualification.**
